clause: Vector domain binding: studio.vector command family + kind=vector layer + engine boundary [STU-VEC-001,STU-VEC-041,STU-VEC-042,STU-VEC-045]

scope.summary: Wire the handshake_core::studio::vector domain to the studio-engine VectorEngine (MT-016) through the typed boundary only (no GPU/tessellation dep in handshake_core): register the studio.vector.<command>.v<N> command family over the MT-007 command surface, bind StudioLayer kind=vector to StudioVectorPath/StudioVectorNetwork (MT-002), route all mutations through studio.vector EventLedger events + typed studio_* SurrealDB authority (MT-003/MT-004), lossless path->network promotion + explicit network->path flatten command, and geometry precision carried zoom/artboard-independent with decode/encode only at the API boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite are forbidden.
acceptance_criteria: studio.vector command family routes through VectorEngine boundary + EventLedger + typed SurrealDB authority; lossless promotion; precision at API boundary; no GPU dependency leak; PostgreSQL/SQLite rejected
expected_tests: live: studio.vector command mutation emits ledger event + lands in studio_* authority via PromotionGate
test: path->network promotion lossless; network->path is explicit flatten only; no wgpu dep in handshake_core

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No vector domain wiring; all 14.5 MTs unroutable and unauditable.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
